findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "cereal_pangenome_presence" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_data, annotate_genes, wheat_gene_view · Private data: search_data, data_sources, wheat_gene_in_cultivars, watkins_accession, snp_phenotypes, brapi_germplasm_studies, get_paper, blast_sequence · Public sink: watkins_gene_haplotypes, snp_haplotype_carriers, wheat_gene_view.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_data, annotate_genes, wheat_gene_view · Private data: search_data, data_sources, wheat_gene_in_cultivars, watkins_accession, snp_phenotypes, brapi_germplasm_studies, get_paper, blast_sequence · Public sink: watkins_gene_haplotypes, snp_haplotype_carriers, wheat_gene_view

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
